subject: [NAME] - Machine Learning
text:
Hi [NAME],

Noticed your ML background and work at [COMPANY]. I wanted to reach out as we
support teams like Onfido, Veriff, and VIDA to help them identify failure
modes faster and boost data quality and label accuracy. Given [COMPANY]'s
focus on IDV, I imagine you are solving for similar model accuracy in
high-stakes situations?

Quick context - Encord's a SF-based data development platform used by 200+
AI teams to tighten the annotation-to-model feedback loop. Teams in
regulated industries use us for our workflow orchestrator
(model-assisted pre-labeling, consensus, human QA, validation) - all with
full data lineage tracking and secure deployment built in.

Would love to hear your feedback on what we've built.  Flexible next week
before Thanksgiving if you're open to a quick chat.

subject: video object tracking using SAM3
text:
Hi [NAME],

Thanks for your interest in Encord! Just wanted to give you a shout that
*SAM3** is now available *on the Encord platform! Thought this might be
interesting to show you, especially for use cases like object detecting,
segmenting, and tracking in images + videos using text and visual prompts.

In case Encord is new to you, we work with Sportstech companies like Veo,
Swingvision, Hudl, and Spiideo on use cases like edge-case athlete tracking
(bad weather, multi-tracking, etc). We render videos natively, offer
model-assisted pre-labeling, automated QA with HITL review, and model
evaluation to boost data throughput and keep model quality strong.

Would love to get your feedback and hear what you're focused on lately :)
I'm pretty flexible next week before Thanksgiving - let me know.

subject: Scaling AV data pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

thought now is a good time to connect since we are working with companies
